notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
--initial-rtt-timeout and --max-rtt-timeout reduce how long Nmap waits for responses before marking ports. Dramatically speeds up scans — in example: 39s → 12s. But: hosts responding slowly will be missed entirely.

=== ACCURACY TRADE-OFF ===
In the CPTS example, aggressive RTT values caused 2 hosts to disappear from results. Always validate by comparing port/host count to standard scan. Low RTT = more missed results on high-latency targets.

=== --max-retries ===
Default 10 retries accounts for packet loss. --max-retries 0 eliminates re-sends: no response on first try = port skipped. Can drop 1-2 ports requiring retry to respond consistently. Best on low-loss internal networks.
